meta.name: migrate-slack-agents
meta.description: Migrate a classic single-bot Slack install to one provisioned Slack app per existing agent group while preserving agent identities, workspaces, memory, and wiring behavior — or record the operator's choice to stay on classic, which remains supported. Use when /update-nanoclaw surfaces the Slack agents requirement, or standalone any time later.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 迁移 Slack 机器人架构为每组独立应用，保留身份与记忆
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在使用经典 Slack 机器人并需按 agent 分组独立应用
copy.tagline_en: Migrate classic Slack bots to per-agent apps, preserving identities and memory
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run a classic Slack bot setup and need per-agent Slack apps

howto.what: 把经典的单机器人 Slack 安装,迁移成每个已有 agent group 一个独立 Slack 应用(命名 slack-<slug>),保留原有身份、工作区、记忆和接线行为;也可以只记录你选择继续用经典模式。全程由操作者引导、可断点续做,不新建 agent group,也不改 agent 工作区。
howto.when: 当 /update-nanoclaw 提示 Slack agents 要求时接手,或之后任何时候单独运行 /migrate-slack-agents。它会先确认安装处于经典共享机器人状态,再让你选择迁移或维持现状。

say.text: 帮我迁移 Slack agents,先给我看 dry-run 映射表
say.note: 它会盘点每个 group 并列出迁移映射,等你确认。

say.text: 这次先留在经典 Slack,帮我记录这个决定
say.note: 不做任何改动,只登记更新要求。

say.text: 继续上次的 Slack 迁移,从断点恢复
say.note: 按已记录的 slug 和账本续做,不新建应用。

howto.what_en: Turns a classic single-bot Slack install into one provisioned Slack app per existing agent group (slack-<slug>), keeping identities, workspaces, memory and wiring — or records staying on classic. Resumable; creates no agent group.
howto.when_en: Triggers when /update-nanoclaw surfaces the Slack agents requirement, or standalone any time later. It first confirms classic shared-bot state, then lets you choose to migrate or stay on classic.

say_en.text: Migrate my Slack agents and show the dry-run map first
say_en.note: Inventories each group and lists the proposed mapping for confirmation.

say_en.text: Stay on classic Slack and record that decision
say_en.note: Makes no changes; only acknowledges the update requirement.

say_en.text: Resume the Slack migration from where it stopped
say_en.note: Continues from recorded slugs and ledger, no new apps.
